events.name: Christmas Wedding Planner
events.description: Event planner Kelsey Wilson believes she is about to achieve her big break as she arranges the lavish Christmas wedding of her beloved cousin. Everything seems to be progressing smoothly until Connor McClane, a private detective, shows up on the scene to disrupt proceedings on behalf of a mysterious employer. While his appearance threatens to undo all her hard work, Kelsey finds she cannot help but be won over by Connor's charms, and as the nuptials draw closer the truth about his mission is revealed. Festive romance, starring Jocelyn Hudon and Stephen Huszar

events.name: Christmas with a Crown
events.description: When Cassie, a successful woman, returns to her hometown to revive her family's Christmas festival, she meets a dashing stranger who's volunteered to help organise the event. Sparks begin to fly between them, but little does she know that he is really a prince in disguise who is longing to find the true spirit of the holidays - but it will take a Christmas miracle of royal proportions for their hearts to meet as one. Romantic drama, starring Lisa Durupt and Marcus Rosner

events.name: Six Degrees of Santa
events.description: Christmas enthusiast and single mother Harper creates a program dubbed Six Degrees of Santa in which anonymous 'Santas' give a gift to be passed along, temporarily enjoyed, and re-gifted indefinitely. Her goal is to create a Christmas experience that's real-life, magical, and unexpected. When Harper's own gift lands in the hands of leading internet entrepreneur Jason, he's convinced that the original Santa might be his soul mate. He seeks out Harper, as the architect of the program, to help him track down this mystery woman. Romantic comedy, starring Kathryn Davis and Steve Lund

event.name: Christmas Wedding Planner
event.description: Event planner Kelsey Wilson believes she is about to achieve her big break as she arranges the lavish Christmas wedding of her beloved cousin. Everything seems to be progressing smoothly until Connor McClane, a private detective, shows up on the scene to disrupt proceedings on behalf of a mysterious employer. While his appearance threatens to undo all her hard work, Kelsey finds she cannot help but be won over by Connor's charms, and as the nuptials draw closer the truth about his mission is revealed. Festive romance, starring Jocelyn Hudon and Stephen Huszar

event.name: Six Degrees of Santa
event.description: Christmas enthusiast and single mother Harper creates a program dubbed Six Degrees of Santa in which anonymous 'Santas' give a gift to be passed along, temporarily enjoyed, and re-gifted indefinitely. Her goal is to create a Christmas experience that's real-life, magical, and unexpected. When Harper's own gift lands in the hands of leading internet entrepreneur Jason, he's convinced that the original Santa might be his soul mate. He seeks out Harper, as the architect of the program, to help him track down this mystery woman. Romantic comedy, starring Kathryn Davis and Steve Lund
